individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/diagram illustrating the composition of camera exposure time versus illumination overhead for different input settings; it is not a data plot of averaged experimental replicates.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram, not a plot of replicate data, so error bars are not applicable.

individual-data-points.explanation: This is a continuous photobleaching decay curve averaged across three experiments with shaded mean±s.e.m. bands; individual data points are not typically required or practical for this type of continuous line/curve plot.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Curves were normalized to the maximum fluorescence intensity of each experiment. Data represents the average of three independent experiments. Shaded areas represent mean±s.e.m.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Shaded error bands are shown and explicitly defined as mean±s.e.m. in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel C plots a mean (±s.e.m.) ΔROS value for each light-power condition (n=3 independent experiments per point) but does not show the individual replicate values underlying each mean, even though sample size per group is small (n=3).

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represent the mean±s.e.m. of three independent experiments.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are visible on the plotted points and are defined in the caption as mean±s.e.m. of three independent experiments.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each line already represents an individual cell's migration track (raw data for each of the n cells), so no additional averaging requiring individual data points applies.

error-bars-defined.explanation: This panel shows raw individual migration tracks rather than averaged data, so error bars are not needed and none are present.

individual-data-points.explanation: Individual data points for each cell are overlaid as dots on top of the bar graph of mean migration speed.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Migration speed (mean±s.e.m.) of each cell depicted in D.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars shown on the bar graph are defined in the caption as mean±s.e.m.

micrograph-scale-bar.from_the_caption: Scale bars: 10 μm for whole-cell images and 2 μm for magnified images.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel F consists of micrograph images, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel F is a set of micrographs, not a plot, so error bars do not apply.

individual-data-points.explanation: This is a time-course line plot of normalized cell area (mean±s.e.m., n=5); individual data points are not typically required for continuous time-series line graphs of this kind.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Measurements were normalized to initial cell area at time zero. Results represent mean±s.e.m. (P-values correspond to Student's t-test for area under the curve).
